checks.name: the planted contract carries the measured window in its own bytecode
the proof binds the precompile mark exactly, with no rounding in between
an honest proof whose price matches the live mark VERIFIES
a proof submitted against a different asset is refused
a bent proof is refused even when the price is right
an unanswerable asset is refused rather than compared against zero
a price one grid step outside the contract's own bound is refused, by construction
a price inside the window is still accepted, so the gate is a window and not a wall
the tick floor is the binding constraint somewhere, so it is not decoration
a proof whose mark has genuinely moved past the window is REFUSED
the stale proof is refused for its INPUT, not its arithmetic — verifyProof still returns true
